ask_doctor: Ask a doctor before use if you have narrow angle glaucoma
dosage_and_administration: Directions Instill 1 or 2 drops in the affected eye(s) up to four times daily.
inactive_ingredient: Inactive ingredients benzalkonium chloride, boric acid, edetate disodium, purified water, sodium borate, and sodium chloride
indications_and_usage: Uses relieves redness of the eye due to minor eye irritations
keep_out_of_reach_of_children: Keep out of reach of children. If swallowed, get medical help or contact a Poison Control Center right away.

brand_name: Preferred Plus Pharmacy Redness Relief Eye Drops

pregnancy_or_breast_feeding: If pregnant or breast-feeding, ask a health professional before use.

stop_use: Stop use and ask a doctor if you experience eye pain changes in vision continued redness or irritation of the eye, or if the condition worsens or persists for more than 72 hours
warnings: Warnings For external use only Ask a doctor before use if you have narrow angle glaucoma When using this product pupils may become enlarged temporarily to avoid contamination, do not touch tip of container to any surface.
